name: Suspension Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back beneath a suspension trainer with both heels hooked firmly into the low cradles and arms flat on the floor.
Press down through your heels and raise your hips off the ground into a straight bridge with extended legs.
Keep your hips elevated as you curl both heels smoothly inward toward your glutes by contracting your hamstrings.
Extend your legs slowly back to straight while keeping your hips lifted throughout the set.
tips: Maintain steady downward pressure into the cradles so the straps stay evenly tensioned and do not swing.
Keep your hips lifted cleanly throughout each curl without letting your lower back arch.
